class.name: AbilityContainer
class.brief_description: A container node that manages granting, executing, tracking, and revoking gameplay abilities for an entity.
class.description: [AbilityContainer] serves as the runtime ability manager linked to a specific entity. It holds a list of granted [AbilityData] resources, evaluates activation constraints (such as checking tags, costs, and cooldowns), tracks ongoing ability cooldown timers, and provides virtual hook methods for custom logic when granting or executing abilities.

method.name: _can_activate
method.description: Virtual method called to evaluate whether the specified [param ability] can currently be activated. Can be overridden in scripts or inherited C++ classes to implement custom activation conditions.

method.name: _can_be_granted
method.description: Virtual method called to check whether the specified [param ability] is allowed to be added to this container. Override this method to implement custom grant requirements.

method.name: _on_ability_already_granted
method.description: Virtual method triggered when attempting to grant an [param ability] that is already present in this container. Override this to define duplicate ability behaviors (such as leveling up or ignoring duplicate grants).

method.name: clear
method.description: Revokes all currently granted abilities from this container and clears active state tracking.

method.name: get_current_cooldown
method.description: Returns the remaining cooldown time in seconds for the specified [param ability]. Returns [code]0.0[/code] if the ability is off cooldown or not active.

members.member: The collection of [AbilityData] resources currently granted to and usable by this container.
The [NodePath] pointing to the owning entity node (such as a [GAS_Entity]) that this container manages abilities for.

signal.name: _on_abilities_cleared
signal.description: Emitted when all abilities are removed and cleared from this container on the target [param entity].

signal.name: _on_ability_activated
signal.description: Emitted when an [param ability] successfully begins activation on the target [param entity].

signal.name: _on_ability_ended
signal.description: Emitted when an active [param ability] finishes execution or is canceled on the target [param entity].

signal.name: _on_ability_granted
signal.description: Emitted when a new [param ability] is successfully added to this container for the target [param entity].

signal.name: _on_ability_revoked
signal.description: Emitted when an existing [param ability] is removed from this container for the target [param entity].
